name: turboexl3_glm53f
title: TurboEXL3 - GLM 5.3 Flash
summary: GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3 packs (turboderp's self-calibrated branches) streamed from SSD: mlx-serve's own glm5_next model, its GLM bank over the kit's expert stream, every EXL3 linear and the routed experts on turboexl3, on M5-class Macs (NAX).
models: glm5_next with an exllamav3 quantization_config and a turboexl3 expert_streaming bank (the streaming repack of turboderp/GLM-5.3-Flash-exl3 sc_2.10bpw, sc_2.60bpw, sc_3.10bpw, sc_4.10bpw)
kit_note: 26.11.3 has no release yet: build against the kit staged from mlx-serve main 9a173773 or later (MLX_SERVE_KIT=<that kit>). Every switch defaults to the frozen exact configuration's value (src/options.zig: the 64-entry control with DSA_HOLD and PF_TAIL_EVAL on), but PF_INT8 (not exact; 1 to 4 at server start), LOGITS_DUMP (a check) and PF_RUN_TRIM, which are off, and the three whose mechanism is a seam of the kit's stream (PROMPT_KEEP, DEMAND_SPLIT, ADOPT_PIECES), which are off and refused on a kit whose stream lacks the seam (26.11.3's lacks all three), and DEMAND_HELP (now the kit stream's demandFirst), off because its A/B on the kit stream rejected it (g53g2h1). With mlx-serve's split prompt forward (Caps.split_prefill, a PR) the last prompt chunk and its held-back span run as one forward; without it the plugin compiles the split out.
fixture_reason: A streamed EXL3 pack has no small form: the conformance suite needs a tiny pack the plugin can load.
